title: Shipments table with search and pagination
prompt: Show a list of shipments (shipment number, vessel, port of loading, ETD, status) that can be searched by shipment number and is split into pages of 20.

mustNot.why: Use Magenta Table parts, not a raw <table>

rubric: The table has a name (TableContainer title or aria-labelledby).
The search sits in the table toolbar (data-table-toolbar pattern).
Status uses Tag with a color per status.
